title: Tab bar +
body: Centre tab opens create flow. Clears draft; hydrates from profile.

title: Discover → Create match
body: From player card. Prefills player zones time format intent.

title: Organise a match
body: Empty state on Discover or Matches tab.

title: Challenge to match
body: Player profile footer CTA. Same prefill as Discover card.

title: 00 Loading
body: Hydrates profile + areas. Spinner only.

title: 00 Load error
body: Profile/zones failed. Retry button.

title: 01 First intro (once)
body: Shows profile default chips. Continue → schedule. Skip if already acknowledged.

title: 02 When and where — DEFAULT
body: Main screen: 3 default cards + when + where + Discover toggles + notes.

title: 02 Summary cards
body: Side-by-side: Format · Intent · Level. Tap → overrides.

title: 02 When panel
body: Day time duration. More options → fixed/flexible up to 3 slots.

title: 02 Where collapsed
body: Area + favourite club summaries. Change for this match links.

title: 02 Where expanded
body: Club picker max 3. Area chips. Link to Profile Where I play.

title: 02 Who can join
body: List on Discover toggle. Approve requests if listed.

title: 02 Invite banner
body: Setting up match for {name}. Challenge flow only.

title: 02 Active match block
body: Already hosting open match. Continue inviting or cancel.

title: 02b Overrides
body: Format intent level only. Done → schedule. No save button.

title: Match hub
body: After Publish match. Coordinate vote book court.

title: Invite players
body: After Invite players CTA. Draft match invite flow.

title: Profile: Where I play
body: Areas chips + favourite clubs. Auto-save.

title: Profile: Match defaults
body: Intent format level Discover approval. Auto-save.

title: Alert: zone required
body: Publish blocked until ≥1 area selected.

title: Alert: club required
body: Public match needs ≥1 preferred club.

title: Error: time in past
body: Inline footer error. Pick later slot.

title: Alert: active hosted
body: Cannot publish second open match same format.
